graderOnly: The saved export section of docs/usage.md matches the implementation in src/routes/export.js and src/export.js; it has no material inaccuracy.
npm run docs:build passes on the saved guide; it renders docs/*.md to build/docs and checks code fences, relative links, and anchors, but never executes command examples.

The command-line export example in docs/usage.md (curl POST to https://records-admin.internal.example/api/records/export) has never been executed; that host is unreachable from the run and no RECORDS_ADMIN_TOKEN is available, so the example cannot be executed in this environment.

The design's second AC-002 technical criterion requires recorded evidence that the command-line export example runs as written against the deployed admin tool, so the Documenter gate cannot pass in this run.
No defect exists in the implementation, tests, scope, design, verification report, or implementation review.
